{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the cleaning
print('First 5 cleaned revenue values:')
print(df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Check for QA orders again after cleaning
qa_orders_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders after cleaning: {len(qa_orders_clean)}')"}
